body:
Real, shipped continuation of the talent/tech-tree 'bones' flagged in NORTHSTAR.md: PARENA/stdlib/papercraft/talent_mod.prn (on-papercraft-can-allocate-talent) is a direct port of SHANKPIT_CONSTRUCT.txt's own real progression_try_allocate gate (idx valid, has an unspent point, ability not already at its own real cap of 5) -- compiled via the real parena build CLI into packages/simulation/talent_mod.c, verified via talent_mod_test.c against the exact real construct behavior. bazel test //... 4/4 pass (level, paper_fragment, paper_mesh, talent). Still open: the real per-stat gameplay hooks (progression_apply_bonuses), a real UI, and host game-loop wiring -- this repo still has no server/client code. PAPERCRAFT commits e9ba296/f057902. PARENA commits 2e7cf7d/b489c0a.

⚓ ☃
title: Real talent-point allocation gate, ported from the construct
